title: moonhorn
description: I created a Minecraft datapack and its accompanying resource pack, which upgrade the functionality of the vanilla horn and focus on pranking your friends, adding fun to multiplayer.
body:
Thank you for downloading and using this datapack.

Supported versions: 1.21.1-1.21.10
Author: 扫地机器人Moon(Moon_lightC)

You can find me on Bilibili and follow me to support me,thank you!!!

This datapack is designed to be used with the resource pack MoonHornResourcePack (moonhorn). It adds various horns and corresponding crafting recipes, aiming to provide more fun for you and your friends in multiplayer games.

It adds crafting recipes for more than 10 new horns, including two special ones: QQ and WeChat horns. You can craft them using the recipes shown in the images below. The files custom0-11 in the resource pack path assetsmoonhornsoundscustom can be modified and replaced by users with files of the same name; of course, their extensions must be .ogg. These sound effects will be called in the datapack and are intended to prank your friends. You need to make sure all players you want to prank have installed your modified resource pack. The crafting recipes corresponding to your custom sound effects are shown in the image below:

(Currently, there are no images available...)

Can't find the sound effects you want to use or only want to use QQ and WeChat notification sounds? Don’t worry. If custom sound effects are not replaced, they will play selected original Minecraft cave and Nether sounds...
